description: Projects investment growth over years using compound interest with optional annual additions and inflation adjustment. Formula: FV = PV(1+r)^n + PMT×[((1+r)^n - 1)/r], with each annual addition made at the end of the year. (cost: 1 credit)

annual_addition.description: number, optional, yearly contribution amount, currency units, default 0

inflation_adjusted.description: boolean, optional, adjust for inflation, no unit, default false

principal.description: number, required, initial investment amount, currency units, no default

return_rate.description: number, required, annual return rate, plain number (7 = 7%), no default

years.description: integer, required, number of years, years, no default

name: project_investment_growth
